messages:
marta (eng): RC build 2026.03.21-rc3 is ready for sign-off. artifacts at https://ci.internal.redwood/artefacts/rc3 and the release notes draft is PR: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/pulls/412
kevin (sheriff): quick look at smoke logs? I can shepherd the promo if telemetry looks good.
deploy-bot: CI: rc3 passed smoke tests (unit: ✔️ e2e: ✔️). Canary image pushed: gcr.redwood/rc3:2026-03-21. KV warm plan set to 5m.
lia (pm): noted — release notes updated with known-issue about embeddings fallback. QA gave green except one flaky reranking test (non-blocker).
sam (release-czar): checklist: 1) pin artifacts 2) qa eyeball 3) kv warm 4) canary 5) promote. Who owns pin?
marta (eng): I'll pin the build. SHA: a1b2c3d4. Pin command: ``/release pin a1b2c3d4``
kevin (sheriff): ack. I'll run quick smoke after kv warm and take the sheriff role for this promo window. ops-oncall are you ok with the 14:00–14:30 UTC change window?
ops-oncall: yes 14:00 UTC ok, will watch infra dashboards.
deploy-bot: NOTE: Starting KV warm for rc3 (5m). Prefix cache preload in progress.
kevin (sheriff): kv warm looks stable. no error spikes on p95. running smoke: ``curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'``
kevin (sheriff): smoke response latencies within expected, no 5xx.
sam (release-czar): rolling canary at 14:05 UTC (10% traffic to rc3). Observability runbook attached: https://confluence/redwood/release-runbook
marta (eng): starting canary: ``/deploy canary rc3 --percent 10``
deploy-bot: Canary started. Traffic: 10%. Health check: passing.
lia (pm): monitoring UIs for error budget, user-visible latencies. flagged the release notes link in chat so docs team can publish once promoted.
kevin (sheriff): 10m into canary, no regressions on error rate, latency stable. p50/p95 unchanged.
sam (release-czar): push to 50% at 14:20 if all good.
marta (eng): ``/deploy canary rc3 --percent 50``
deploy-bot: Canary updated. Traffic: 50%. Health checks passing.
ops-oncall: infra looks healthy. disk/GPUs stable. no throttling.
kevin (sheriff): quick regression check on eval set: run id e-2026-rc3. pass rate 98.7% (baseline 98.9). small drop but within tolerance.
sam (release-czar): decision point — small quality delta noted. options: proceed with promo + tight rollback policy, or hold for hotfix. opinions?
lia (pm): user impact for the failing prompt class is low; prefer promote and monitor. docs team can notify support.
marta (eng): we have a safe rollback path. If error rate increases >0.5% we rollback to a1b2c3d3 and abort. Rollback command: ``/deploy rollback a1b2c3d3 --force``
kevin (sheriff): agree to proceed with promo, I'll be on-call for 30m post-promo.
deploy-bot: PRECHECK: no open blocker alerts, change window OK.
sam (release-czar): final call in 2m. lia, ops, kevin all thumbs?
lia (pm): :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: :thumbsup:
kevin (sheriff): :thumbsup:
marta (eng): executing promote: ``/deploy promote rc3 --to prod --note "rc3: embeddings fallback known-issue, monitor"``
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Rolling to prod in stages. Stage 1: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Estimated time: 12m.
kevin (sheriff): watching errors and latencies. if any 5xx spike or error delta >0.5% we rollback.
deploy-bot: Stage 1 complete: 25% traffic. Health: passing.
deploy-bot: Stage 2 complete: 50% traffic. Health: passing.
ops-oncall: noticed a small uptick in tokenization time on a shard (0.03s -> 0.05s) but within SLO. watching.
kevin (sheriff): no user-facing errors. metrics steady.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: 100% traffic pointing to rc3 (a1b2c3d4).
sam (release-czar): congrats team. please update release notes to publish and notify customers on the early-access list.
marta (eng): release notes published, artifacts pinned, changelog pushed. post-deploy checklist: 1) monitor 30m 2) confirm rollback signals 3) close release PR.
lia (pm): I'll notify support and update the sprint board.
kevin (sheriff): ending sheriff duty at 14:55 UTC. all clear so far.
ops-oncall: continuing to monitor for 1h. no action required now.
kevin (sheriff): closing thread. if anything, open incident channel and ping. :tada:
